items.quote: I changed my mission statement. And instead of ... “Helping real estate companies to make more money… I put, “My mission is to Support Real Estate Investors and Home Buyers!”
they are the first who suffer because of the overall low standards in DUBAI’s real estate services.
items.statement: Low standards in DUBAI’s real estate services cause financial instability for investors and home buyers.

items.quote: All of this is caused by a broken sales process, low-level skills, high-pressure sales techniques, and a lack of expertise.
items.statement: A broken sales process contributes to low-level skills and high-pressure sales techniques.

items.quote: We can change it TOGETHER with real estate companies, SIMPLY by creating an effective sales process while advancing their agents' sales skills.
items.statement: Creating an effective sales process can help real estate companies improve their agents' skills.

items.quote: This enables them to work with clients, not against them in a battle to close a deal.
items.statement: Agents should work with clients rather than against them to close deals.

items.quote: Only when the real estate company can do so will they achieve consistency in reaching their targets, increasing their closing rates, and, as a result, scaling their business without requiring additional resources.
items.statement: Consistency in reaching business targets improves closing rates and allows scaling without extra resources.

overview: LinkedIn post reflecting a change in mission statement related to real estate services.
